messages:
Lena: Heads-up: guest arriving at 2:15 with a small glass harp (delicate) and two parcels marked "GLASS - HANDLE WITH CARE". Wants a quiet table in meeting room B and a temp badge. :musical_note: :package:
Front Desk: Okay — can you DM full name and phone so we can pre-print? Also note: meeting room B has glass coffee table; recommend acoustic mat and 'do not touch' sign.
Lena: Name is Dr. Ana Ribeiro, phone 555-4422. She'll be with a colleague. Arriving by cab, might need help carrying the harp from street stairs.
Courier-Bot: Delivery notice logged at 14:02 for 2 parcels to "Dr. Ana Ribeiro". Handling: fragile (glass). Driver ETA 14:10.
Tom: I can be lobby escort at 14:10 and help carry the harp. Happy to take the awkward end.
Front Desk: Pre-printing badge as:
```
Visitor: Dr. Ana Ribeiro
Company: Guest
Badge: TEMP-ANA-215
Notes: Glass harp + 2 fragile parcels. Escort to MR-B, put acoustic mat down.
```
Front Desk: We'll reserve Meeting Room B 14:15-15:00 and place an A-frame sign: "Fragile demo in progress - please do not enter".
Facilities: I'll drop an acoustic mat and move the plant pot away. If stairs are involved, bring the folding dolly from storage A.
Arun: Quick FYI on IDs: building accepts passport or driver's license. If name on package differs (sometimes courier uses previous employer) we need the visitor to sign a delivery acceptance form.
Lena: Packages are addressed correctly. I'll tell the driver to bring the dolly. Thanks everyone!
Tom: See you in lobby. I'll also bring a soft blanket from my team room in case we need extra padding. :sweat_smile:
Front Desk: Badge printed and in tray. Meeting Room B reserved and signs out. Courier instructed to leave items with reception and sign the log.
Lena: Really appreciate it  Ana's harp is tiny but old, would hate for it to chime its last note. :pray:
